question: How do I queue my COUNT, GRADE, ENTRY or MONTH job so that the runner runs it from the release folder?

commands.name: grade-month
commands.does: queues one GRADE job (1 to 3 variants on Sep-Dec 2025; JOB_GRADE_V11, the chain v2_0_6: v2_0_5 with Outcomes, the menu and the card in one process, perfire and the hand-off from the kept rows) or one MONTH job (the Jan-Apr 2026 reads of a decided variant, --from-job <its GRADE job>; JOB_MONTH_V11, the chain v2_2_6: v2_2_5 with Outcomes, the menu and the card in one process, perfire from the kept rows); with --dry it only prints the filled job. A variant is graded once: a change is a new variant. The job gives its chain FEED_GATE and RESEARCH_STORE of --job-settings: Outcomes reads the feed gate and the research days from them

args.name: --settings
args.meaning: this machine's settings file (KEY=VALUE lines read by _tools/settings_v1.py); always named on the command line

args.name: RUN
args.meaning: the run tag

args.name: KIND
args.meaning: GRADE, ENTRY or MONTH

args.name: IDEA
args.meaning: the idea

args.name: ITEMS
args.meaning: 1 to 3 different variant names, each registered in VARIANTS before its job

args.name: --from-job
args.meaning: ENTRY and MONTH: the GRADE job of the idea (ENTRY: only variants whose hand-off R1 passed; MONTH: only PASS or NEEDS MORE MONTHS)

args.name: --forward-only
args.meaning: MONTH only: V is the other side of a STOP variant V0 (same definition, other lean, VARIANTS reason FORWARD ONLY OF V0); --from-job is V0's GRADE job; decided by decide_forward_v2.py

args.name: --dry
args.meaning: every check, then print the filled job

commands.writes: with --dry: nothing. Without: the twin, one RUNS row and the job in IN; the job writes RUN/receipts/<N>_GRADE_<IDEA>/ (the hand-off for decide_v2) or RUN/receipts/<N>_MONTH_<IDEA>/ (one read per Jan-Apr month)

refuses.when: REFUSED: <reason> on stderr: as count, and a variant already graded (never re-run), a MONTH whose GRADE job has no receipts yet

commands.name: count
commands.does: checks everything, then queues one COUNT job (up to 3 definitions); with --dry it only prints the filled job

args.name: --settings
args.meaning: this machine's settings file (KEY=VALUE lines read by _tools/settings_v1.py); always named on the command line

args.name: --job-settings
args.meaning: the settings file of the machine that runs the job (the job runner's), when it is another one (default: --settings)

args.name: RUN
args.meaning: the run tag: the folder RESEARCH_ROOT/ALARM_DESIGN/runs/<RUN>; the seat is the part before _

args.name: KIND
args.meaning: COUNT

args.name: IDEA
args.meaning: the idea: capitals and digits, starting with a letter; its claim file runs/IDEAS_CLAIMED/<RUN>_<IDEA>.txt must exist

args.name: ITEMS
args.meaning: V=ideas/<IDEA>/defs/<V>.json, comma separated, at most 3; each window must cover 20250910 to 20260430

args.name: --queue
args.meaning: a queue Q_V1..Q_V21 (default: the first empty one)

args.name: --behind
args.meaning: allow a queue that holds only your own jobs (your 3rd job then waits there)

args.name: --dry
args.meaning: every check, then print the filled job; claims, writes and queues nothing

commands.writes: with --dry: nothing. Without: the job twin RUN/jobs/<N>_judge_<SEAT>_COUNT_<IDEA>.job.sh, one RUNS row, the job in <RUNNER_QUEUES>/<Q_Vn>/IN. The job then writes RUN/receipts/<N>_COUNT_<IDEA>/ (STAGES.tsv, COUNT_<V>.tsv, FIRST20_<V>.tsv, DISK.tsv, SHA16.txt, det logs) and SCRATCH/work_<RUN>/<N>_COUNT_<IDEA>/

refuses.when: REFUSED: <reason> on stderr. No --settings; a key it needs is empty (RESEARCH_ROOT, RUNNER_QUEUES, RUNNER_ALLOC, SCRATCH, and for the job PYTHON, LAB_DAYS and RESEARCH_STORE); a bad run tag, kind or name; no run folder; the idea not claimed; a definition outside ideas/<IDEA>/, missing, or whose window misses 20250910-20260430; more than 3 definitions; your job budget (2 jobs, 3 with --behind); no empty queue; SCRATCH free under 60,000 MB plus WRITES_MB; the run's scratch still on SCRATCH_DISK over 10,000 MB (ask DSK on the board); a template or reg_append_v1.py whose sha16 changed; a placeholder left; a refused word; bash -n failed; the allocator failed

rules: the way a KIT_V5 agent queues every job since ALARM_V1_9: COUNT (JOB_COUNT_V6), GRADE (JOB_GRADE_V11, the chain v2_0_6: v2_0_5 with Outcomes, the menu and the card in one process, perfire and the hand-off from the kept rows), ENTRY (JOB_ENTRY_V6) and MONTH (JOB_MONTH_V11, the chain v2_2_6: v2_2_5 with Outcomes, the menu and the card in one process, perfire from the kept rows); KIND CLEAN is refused (CLEAN REMOVED: the owner 31 Oct 2026 10:51 Berlin; scratch cleanup is DSK's, on the owner's word); queue_job_v5, queue_job_v6, queue_job_v7 and queue_job_v8 are past editions
run --dry first; it claims, writes and queues nothing
never deletes, never overwrites (the twin is opened new; IN is written as .part then renamed)
reads no market data; the job reads code only inside the release folder (@@ALARM@@) and checks each pin's sha16 there
the quiet window is gone (the owner 30 Oct 2026 23:32 Berlin): jobs can be queued at any hour

the run's disk budget (10,000 MB) counts a finished job's measured scratch only while its folder SCRATCH/work_<RUN>/<JOB> is on SCRATCH_DISK, so DSK's sweep frees it; on a DISK BUDGET refusal ask DSK on the board

outputs.where: <RESEARCH_ROOT>/ALARM_DESIGN/runs/<RUN>/registers/RUNS.tsv: one row per queued job, at queue time
RUN/receipts/<N>_<KIND>_<IDEA>/STAGES.tsv: one line per stage of the job, written as it runs
RUN/receipts/<N>_COUNT_<IDEA>/COUNT_<V>.tsv: fires, waves and coins per Sep-Dec month
RUN/receipts/<N>_COUNT_<IDEA>/FIRST20_<V>.tsv: the header and first 20 fires of the detection, every detect.py column (coin and t first)
